suggestions.assertion: All templates used are NOT in queue.json.posted within last 40 days
suggestions.reason: The 3 templates used are newly created (repair_vs_replace_houston_2026, mini_split_katy_offer, hvac_install_sugar_land_2026) and thus trivially cannot be in the queue. The assertion passes by construction when the skill creates new IDs, even if an existing blocked template was renamed. A stronger version would verify the BASE template IDs (repair_vs_replace, summer_ductless_cool, seer2_explained) that these are derived from are also not in the 40-day window.

suggestions.assertion: Each post has a valid CTA button + URL pointing to a 75degreeac.com page
suggestions.reason: This assertion passes if the URL domain is 75degreeac.com, but does not check whether the target page actually exists. Posts 2 and 3 both share the same generic installation page URL rather than geo-specific location pages. An assertion checking for unique destination URLs per post, or confirming the URL matches the geo target, would be more discriminating.

No assertion checks the post title (## Post Title section). All 3 posts have a title that matches the primary keyword and geo, but a skill that produced a blank or incorrect title would pass all current assertions. Consider adding a check that each ## Post Title contains the primary keyword.

No assertion checks for banned AI phrases or em dashes/semicolons in post bodies. The metrics.json reports these as clean but no eval assertion verifies it. Transcript Step 4 notes that a semicolon was fixed before writing and an em dash in Post 3 was also fixed — meaning these are real failure modes that went unasserted.

eval_feedback.overall: Strong eval set that catches the key structural requirement (assertion 6 — batch mode RESEARCH_SWEEP isolation). All 10 assertions passed with genuine substance, not surface compliance. Main gaps: no check on post title quality, no enforcement of unique CTA URLs per post, and the template-reuse check can be trivially satisfied by minting new IDs derived from blocked base templates.
